method: Midwest-only historical exposure proxy for testing whether the existing MUSA specification generalizes
notes: This is not presented as an exact current gallon-exposure estimate.

Before the Fikes acquisition, Casey's network was overwhelmingly concentrated in EIA's Midwest/PADD 2 states; the 2026 Form 10-K says roughly half of all stores are in Iowa, Missouri, and Illinois alone.
Fikes added 198 stores during F2025 Q3, primarily increasing Gulf Coast/PADD 3 exposure.
A 93.3% Midwest / 6.7% Gulf Coast sensitivity and a 90% / 10% sensitivity produce the same trust-gate failure, so the conclusion does not depend on the Midwest-only proxy.
A production Casey's nowcast should replace this file with dated gallon-exposure weights or, second best, audited store-location counts.
